page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCadsv6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an AMD processor. The instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced resource ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 614 GB of local disk storage and is compatible with Premium Storage options. It operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance does not include integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the DC16ads_v6 offers a predictable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. The inclusion of local storage and Premium Storage capability makes it suitable for database hosting, web serving, and application backends requiring consistent performance without the overhead of GPU acceleration.
